title: Finite locally constant set sheaves are finite sheaves
statement: Let Y be a scheme and F a sheaf of types on the small etale site of Y. If an etale cover trivializes F on each member as a constant sheaf with a finite type value, then IsFiniteSheaf F.

source.place: Definition 03RU (4), Lemma 03Q1 (3), and Remark 03P5; finite-stalk consequence formulated for the Lean IsFiniteSheaf predicate

proof.text: Unpack the finite constant-value cover. For each separably closed geometric point s, choose a cover member over its image and lift s to that member using Cover.exists_eq and exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed. This supplies a in the fiber of U at s.

Represent an arbitrary stalk element z by a section t on a pointed neighbourhood (V,b), using Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective. Choose a common pointed refinement W of (V,b) and (U,a), by IsCofilteredOrEmpty.cone_objs. The section restricts to a section t′ over the object W -> U of the localized site.

Let eta be the constant-presheaf sheafification map and pi the inverse of the supplied local constant-sheaf isomorphism. The map pi is an epimorphism, hence locally surjective. The map eta is locally surjective by the Mathlib instance Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J (toSheafify J P); composition preserves local surjectivity. Apply the over-point (pointSmallEtale s).over a to the covering image sieve of t′. It supplies a further pointed refinement R and m in the constant value with (eta >> pi)(m) equal to the restriction of t′. These are direct applications of Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi, the sheafification instance, and Point.jointly_surjective; no auxiliary unproved theorem is introduced.

Use naturality of eta >> pi and Point.toPresheafFiber_w along R -> U, R -> W, and W -> V to show that the germ of m at (U,a) is z. Thus the finite constant value surjects onto the original stalk. Finite.of_surjective makes that stalk finite, and ConcreteCategory.isFinitelyGenerated_iff_finite supplies the field of IsFiniteSheaf. The empty constant value case follows from the same surjection, and no nonemptiness of Y is assumed.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03RU (4), 03Q1 (3), 03PR and 03PQ; explicit germ argument adapted from the proved private germ_constant_epi_surjective in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteTypeEtaleModuleStalk, using Mathlib sites APIs.

lean.statement: theorem isFiniteSheaf_of_finite_locally_constant_sets {Y : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (hF : ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage Y, ∀ i, ∃ S : Type (u + 1), Finite S ∧ Nonempty ((F.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅ (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (Type (u + 1))).obj S)) : IsFiniteSheaf F
